# Population Composition

True M4 CE is post-selection only. Population-level exact OT uses frozen 48-reference capacities; instance nearest-reference counts separately expose concentration. Full-F40 and within-niche Top5 NN are structural similarity proxies, not gradient redundancy. All three preregistered arms proceed to training regardless of this table.
